assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of symptomatic atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome.
The patient has a history of unexplained cardiac arrhythmias.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture continuous electrocardiographic data during daily activities.
The service addresses the clinical need to monitor for rhythm disturbances associated with diagnosis codes I48.91, I49.5, and I49.9.
The diagnosis codes are I48.91, I49.5, and I49.9.
